name: Aliased-Default Type Confusion
essence: A shared mutable default is seeded with the wrong type, and a later caller crashes on it.

examples.summary: The default list outlives the call. A string stored in it crashes the next read of sku.
examples.mechanism: Python evaluates a mutable default once and reuses that object. The second call appends a str into the list the third call still indexes as a dict (CWE-843).
examples.observed_output:
pen
TypeError: string indices must be integers, not 'str'
examples.expected_behavior: sku lines pen, ink, and pad, each from its own list

ingredients.suggests: Every omitted bag argument reuses and mutates the same default list.
A string is stored among dictionaries and later indexed using the sku key.

examples.summary: A shared default bag retains a string that a later caller treats as a product note.
examples.mechanism: The default parameter references one module-level array across calls; reading sku on its string element yields undefined and the string-method call throws.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')
examples.expected_behavior: Each call receives its own bag and the last call prints labels PAD.

ingredients.suggests: Every omitted bag argument aliases the same array and each stash call mutates it.
A string is stored among product notes and later consumed through its nonexistent sku property.

examples.summary: Calls using the default shared bag retain a string that fails the later note assertion.
examples.mechanism: The []any escape hatch permits heterogeneous contents; a nil argument selects one shared default slice and the map assertion panics.
examples.observed_output: panic: interface conversion: interface {} is string, not map[string]string
examples.expected_behavior: Each caller should receive an isolated bag containing only product notes.

ingredients.suggests: Omitted bags resolve to the same package slice and append into it.
The []any bag contains a string but the consumer asserts map notes.

examples.summary: A shallowly cloned bag carries a string into another caller numeric-shaped notes.
examples.mechanism: Rc<RefCell<_>> shared storage and Any downcasts provide the score-1 aliased dynamic default form. Cloning the packing object aliases the same mutable note bag. A string is added to a bag subsequently consumed as Note objects.
examples.expected_behavior: Each caller has a separate note bag or validates note types.

ingredients.suggests: Cloning the packing object aliases the same mutable note bag.
A string is added to a bag subsequently consumed as Note objects.
